name: Magnitude International Ltd
summary: Magnitude International Ltd provides mechanical and electrical engineering service in Singapore. It engages in provision of electrical installation and licensing services for greenfield and brownfield electrical installation projects. The company also offers electrical installation for private and public housing, commercial and mixed-use developments, and other public facilities; and installs generators, transformers, high and low tension systems, lightning protection systems, underground infrastructures, telecommunication systems, security systems, solar panel systems, capacitor banks, fire alarms and electric vehicle chargers.
